ValidationRule.description: Restrict users from adding additional issues on closed complaints
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, NOT(ISNEW()), OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Customer_Complaint', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Non_Customer_Complaint' ), IsClosed, OR( (ISCHANGED(IDR_Second_Issue__c) && IDR_Second_Issue__c), (ISCHANGED(IDR_Third_Issue__c) && IDR_Third_Issue__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot add additional issues on closed complaints
